Darth Vader's Return'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[January]] [[1999]]''[[Star Wars Missions 17: Darth Vader's Return]]'' |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=72 |isbn=059084413X |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline=[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]''[[Star Wars Missions 17: Darth Vader's Return]]'' and the next three ''Star Wars Missions'' books tell a continuous story that starts with Darth Vader returning to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was published by [[Scholastic]] in [[January]] [[1999]].
